description: GitHub Actions workflows for CI, commit and PR title linting, markdown link checks, security analysis and labels.
name: github-ci

ops.content:
## github-ci

GitHub Actions workflows with every action pinned by commit SHA. Package scripts run with `--if-present` and the commit lint job skips its work without a commitlint configuration, so the workflows work for any selection. Jobs on the pull request path run on the `BLACKSMITH_RUNNER` repository variable when it is set and on `ubuntu-latest` otherwise. A superseded run is cancelled only on a pull request.

Key files:

- `.github/workflows/ci.yml`: job "check" runs typecheck, lint, format check and test, each only when the Project has that script; job "Commitlint" lints the commits of a pull request when the Project has a commitlint configuration; job "CI passed" fails when either one fails or is cancelled.
- `.github/workflows/codeql.yml`, `scorecard.yml`: security analysis on public repositories.
- `.github/workflows/lint-pr.yml`: job "Validate PR title", conventional PR titles.
- `.github/workflows/lint-workflows.yml`: job "actionlint + zizmor".
- `.github/workflows/lint-docs.yml`: job "Check markdown links", lychee over every markdown file, offline, with heading anchors.
- `.github/workflows/labels.yml` and `.github/labels.yml`: job "Sync labels", the label set, synced on `main`.
- `.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md` and `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`: templates you own.
